protocol.name: new_v2_roam_static_posture_independent_v1_family_extension_v1
protocol.family_math: Independent new_bank_v1.py definitions, no historical X1-H/RLCS/CES/Frequency equivalence claim
protocol.source_state: F0v2 Rest thresholds and four candidate metadata states fit source subjects 1-18 resting only; source classifier/scaler fit those native bouts only. Target users never fit state.
protocol.classifier: StandardScaler plus balanced LogisticRegression C=1 max_iter=2000 random_state=20260929, identical to frozen ROAM posture study
protocol.aggregation: mean and standard deviation of all disjoint pure-label 200 ms windows per native bout after 200 ms edge exclusions
protocol.selection: Screen additions by prespecified validation pooled macro-F1, loss and worst-posture F1; do not promote a family solely by final or pooled gain. Baseline F0v2 probabilities must replay frozen posture study within 1e-10.
protocol.scope: Independent first-stage screening of four additional eight-channel family formulas on public ROAM user/posture shift. Native labels and subject partitions match frozen posture study. Only this public axis is tested here; no historical-code or own-device claim.

baseline_replay: all 360 held-out F0v2 vectors within absolute 1e-10
